about: Shared cases for apps/workspace/src/placeholders.ts (test/placeholders.mjs) and myflames/discover.py (test/test_digest_capture.py). Digest texts are copied from MySQL 8.4 / 26.7 and MariaDB 11.4 / 13.0 servers. join_function_calls covers the built-in names that need "(" right after them (MySQL sql/lex.h SYM_FN, MariaDB sql/lex.h sql_functions[]).

parameterize.name: MySQL digest with two literals
parameterize.text: SELECT * FROM `orders` WHERE STATUS = ? ORDER BY `total` DESC LIMIT ?
parameterize.sql: SELECT * FROM `orders` WHERE STATUS = :p1 ORDER BY `total` DESC LIMIT :p2

parameterize.name: IN (...) collapsed list becomes one parameter
row value lists keep their comment
parameterize.sql: SELECT * FROM `t` WHERE ( `a` , `b` ) IN ( (:p1) /* , ... */ ) OR `c` IN ( (:p2) /* , ... */ )

parameterize.name: quotes, backticks and comments are left alone
parameterize.text:
SELECT '?' , `a?b` , "?" /* ? */ FROM t WHERE x = ? -- ?
 AND y = ? # ?
 AND z = ?
parameterize.sql:
SELECT '?' , `a?b` , "?" /* ? */ FROM t WHERE x = :p1 -- ?
 AND y = :p2 # ?
 AND z = :p3

parameterize.name: optimizer hint comment
parameterize.text: SELECT /*+ NO_ICP(t) */ * FROM t WHERE a = ?
parameterize.sql: SELECT /*+ NO_ICP(t) */ * FROM t WHERE a = :p1

parameterize.name: double dash without a space is not a comment
sample text without placeholders is unchanged
parameterize.text: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'new' ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10
parameterize.sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'new' ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10

parameterize.name: unterminated quote runs to the end
parameterize.text: SELECT a FROM t WHERE b = ? AND c = 'cut off ?
parameterize.sql: SELECT a FROM t WHERE b = :p1 AND c = 'cut off ?

digest_query.name: MariaDB has only digest text

row.digest_text: SELECT * FROM `orders` WHERE STATUS = ? ORDER BY `total` DESC LIMIT ?

digest_query.sql: SELECT * FROM `orders` WHERE STATUS = :p1 ORDER BY `total` DESC LIMIT :p2

digest_query.name: truncated MySQL sample falls back to the digest text

row.sample_text: SELECT a FROM t WHERE b IN (1, 2, 3, 4

digest_query.name: truncated sample of a literal-free statement runs the digest text
prepared statement sample keeps its markers
digest text is rejoined so it parses

row.digest_text: SELECT `c` . `name` , SUM ( `o` . `total` ) FROM `orders` `o` JOIN `customers` `c` ON `c` . `id` = `o` . `customer_id` WHERE `c` . `country` = ? GROUP BY `c` . `name` ORDER BY ? DESC LIMIT ?

digest_query.sql: SELECT `c` . `name` , SUM( `o` . `total` ) FROM `orders` `o` JOIN `customers` `c` ON `c` . `id` = `o` . `customer_id` WHERE `c` . `country` = :p1 GROUP BY `c` . `name` ORDER BY :p2 DESC LIMIT :p3

digest_query.name: sample text is sent as recorded, spaces and all

join_function_calls.name: lowercase, extra spaces, several calls
join_function_calls.text: SELECT sum  (a), MAX (b), GROUP_CONCAT (c), DATE_SUB ( NOW ( ) , INTERVAL ? DAY )
join_function_calls.sql: SELECT sum(a), MAX(b), GROUP_CONCAT(c), DATE_SUB( NOW( ) , INTERVAL ? DAY )

join_function_calls.name: quoted names, qualified names, quotes and comments stay
keywords before ( are left alone
join_function_calls.text: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 1 ) d WHERE a IN ( 1 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 2 )
join_function_calls.sql: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 1 ) d WHERE a IN ( 1 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 2 )

join_function_calls.name: longer names that start with a function name
join_function_calls.text: SELECT COUNTRY ( a ) , SUMMARY (b) , MAXIMUM ( c )
join_function_calls.sql: SELECT COUNTRY ( a ) , SUMMARY (b) , MAXIMUM ( c )
